description: Fetch the next part of a read that did not fit in one response (read_id and receipt of the preceding part). OPTIONAL: the first part already counts as delivered and names what later parts hold.

read_id.description: Opaque id returned by the incomplete arroway_read response.

receipt.description: Opaque receipt returned by the immediately preceding part.

name: arroway_continue
title: Receive the next part of an Arroway read
